headline: Kentucky Woman Turns Down $26M Data Center Deal to Keep Farm
meta_description: A Kentucky farmer chose to preserve her land over a $26 million offer to convert her property into a data center.
summary_short: One Kentucky woman rejected a substantial offer to transform her farm into a data center, prioritizing her land and way of life over significant financial gain.
body:
A Kentucky woman has turned down a $26 million offer to convert her farm into a data center, choosing to preserve her land instead of accepting the lucrative deal.

The decision reflects a growing tension between rural communities and tech industry expansion. As data centers increasingly seek locations with available land and infrastructure, property owners face pressure to monetize their holdings. This woman's choice to refuse the offer underscores a commitment to maintaining agricultural heritage and local character over short-term financial incentives.

Her decision resonates with broader conversations about development priorities in rural America, where farming families continue to weigh economic pressures against the desire to keep their land intact for future generations.
quick_facts: Kentucky woman rejected $26 million data center offer
She chose to preserve her farm instead
